identity: Accepted filename position order plus existing quadrant overrides
endpoint: Existing PET intensity proxy; original numerical values and observation masks preserved
arms: observed baseline plus three nested normalized forecast tokens
checkpoint_selection: final training state; no test-based selection
primary_comparison: Longitudinal minus baseline MAE, averaged across valid horizons within each mouse, then across mice
seed_reporting: Per-seed paired differences and initialization SD; seeds are not additional animals
uncertainty: Fixed-prediction descriptive subject resampling; no full-refit VLM permutation significance claim
extension_rule: No hyperparameter or endpoint search; any reduction in complete seed pairs must be based on runtime/resources and disclosed
limitations: Unvalidated anatomical/biological meaning of the PET proxy
Three NaF acquisition components, only one WT component
A gain would not by itself establish personalized future modeling
